name: aws_secret_access_key_recognizer
note: AWS secret access key (40 base64 characters) assigned near an 'aws' + key/password/token keyword, e.g. aws_secret_access_key = "…". Source: detect-secrets (Apache-2.0) detect_secrets/plugins/aws.py (pattern 2, case-insensitive). The match spans from 'aws' to the closing quote, so the variable name is redacted too. Bare 40-character strings without the keyword are not detected.
